This will turn off USB Debugging, Wireless Debugging, and Developer Options together so banking and ID apps pass checks cleanly. You can re-enable everything in 1 tap anytime.
Run once from a computer with ADB (or via Shizuku) to unlock direct 1-tap switches:
• OnePlus / OPPO / Realme (OxygenOS / ColorOS): Turn ON \"Disable permission monitoring\" near the bottom of Developer Options before running pm grant, then turn it back off.
• Xiaomi / Redmi / POCO (HyperOS / MIUI): Turn ON \"USB debugging (Security settings)\" in Developer Options before running pm grant.
